correctness.rationale: For every m>=2 the tight-edge spanning criterion forces at most one zero per arm and at least one entirely tight arm. Opposite parities of the length-two and length-three paths yield exactly the three Delta cases with local alphabet sizes 6, 3, and 3. Graph automorphisms are exactly S_m times pole reversal, and the additional sign action yields the explicitly identified multiset involutions. Burnside counts the fixed six-letter multisets by H_m and fixed three-letter multisets by floor(m/2)+1. The classwise multinomial orbit-size formulas sum to every facet. Standalone exhaustive spanning-tree-coordinate enumeration, separately deriving actual symmetry orbits from permutations of vertices, confirms all classwise orbit-size multisets at m=2,3,4 and full facet counts through m=5. This is an infinite analytic proof with independent finite cross-checks.

value.rationale: The mixed theta graph is the smallest repeated-arm two-terminal family with both even- and odd-length paths and therefore both simplicial and nonsimplicial transportation-ball facets. Its established total facet count grows exponentially as 2*6^m, but the natural symmetry quotient has an exactly classified polynomial count asymptotic to m^5/240. The explicit six/three-color multiset orbit families and stabilizer-recoverable sizes provide meaningful structural data not supplied by an aggregate facet count. This is a natural all-dimensional equivalence classification rather than a numerical slice.
